services.name: speech coaching session
services.story: The main story: a $140 speech coaching session (2½ hours, one to one). A $40 deposit now, and the $100 rest at the studio.

services.name: toast lesson
services.story: A $35 toast lesson. A card is saved for the studio's $20 fee. Alex pays at the studio.

services.name: toast lesson
services.story: A $35 toast lesson for a returning student. Nothing is taken: a YES books it.

services.name: private coaching
services.story: A $55 private lesson (60 minutes), paid in full when booking.

services.name: Custom bit pack
services.story: A custom bit pack for a bit routine, priced from the bit list at $90. Booked once Sam OKs it, and paid at the studio.

services.name: Birthday party comic
services.story: The main story: a 2-hour birthday party, quoted from Alex's plan at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it). Both sign the contract. A $160 deposit holds the date, and the $480 rest goes on the saved card at DONE.

services.story: A company party, quoted from the plan at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it). Both sign the contract, a $160 deposit holds the date, and the rest, with any overtime, goes on the bill after.

services.name: Kids' party
services.story: A $150 kids' party (2 hours). A $40 deposit now, and the $110 rest on the saved card at DONE.

services.name: Kids' party

questions_before_times: The kind of event: a birthday, a company party, a wedding, a bar night or a small private party
The date, and the start and end time
The venue's name and town (for the travel fee), and indoors, outdoors or both
About how many guests, and whether children are there (it sets the material)
Add-ons: an opener, a written roast or toast, a bit pack, an extra hour
At the studio: the coaching or the lesson, and what the speech is for
safety_stop: Someone hurt, a fire, or a fight at the venue right now
license: None for comedy work or speech coaching in most places. A local business license where the city or county asks for one: from the state form.
staff_skills: ["Parties and company shows (leads only)","Weddings (leads only)","Kids' parties (clean material)","Writing (roasts and toasts)","Coaching"]
messages_never: Gate codes, access notes, a child's details, family notes, and the names of people to be named stay on the secure page. The bit list stays on its form. Texts to the comic carry none of them either.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
